ECG heart-rate-variability pipeline (target factory)

Source: R/tar-ecg-hrv.R
tar_ecg_hrv.Rd

Builds a standard resting-ECG pipeline as a list of targets: read -> lead -> R-peaks -> RR -> {HRV time, HRV freq} -> summary, plus an RR-tachogram figure. With more than one record it fans out via dynamic branching (one branch per record) and adds a combined cohort table.

Usage

tar_ecg_hrv(
  name = "ecg",
  records = NULL,
  channel = 1L,
  detector = "pan_tompkins"
)

Arguments

name

Target-name prefix (a string; targets are "<name>_pe" etc.).

records

NULL to use the bundled demo record (MIT-BIH 100 excerpt), or a character vector of WFDB record bases (paths without extension).

channel

Lead index to analyse (MIT-BIH 100: 1 = MLII, 2 = V5).

detector

ecgDetectRpeaks() method (e.g. "pan_tompkins", "hamilton").

Value

A list of target objects to splice into a _targets.R pipeline.

See also

tar_eeg_bandpower(), tar_emg_features(), tar_eda_scr()

Examples

# In _targets.R:
#   library(targets); library(PhysioPipe)
#   list(tar_ecg_hrv())                       # bundled demo, single record
#   list(tar_ecg_hrv(records = my_bases))     # cohort (dynamic branching)
